_schema: summit_county/campaign_finance vision cache v1 — COVER-PAGE STATED TOTALS ONLY (no donor itemization)
_column_contract: Summit's cover box runs Current | Last(=Previous, 2024 sheet) | Cumulative — the REVERSE of the parsed cities' sheet. All three columns are captured VERBATIM and LABELLED here; the builder promotes one per the rule documented in CLAUDE.md. "" = the cell was EMPTY (or a slashed-zero / dash nil mark) on the form; null = a value is present but ILLEGIBLE and was never guessed.
method: vision via the Read tool on a pdftoppm -jpeg -r 200 render of page 1 cropped to the top 80% ($0 API; Claude Code allotment)
notes: Typed cover; Last Report and Cumulative columns left blank.

contributions.note: the Mailing Address cell holds a DESCRIPTION, not an address - 'Unspent funds from the 2014 campaign' - so donor_city/donor_state are honestly blank; this row is the candidate's own carried-over 2014 committee balance, not an outside donation
city printed 'Bountifu' - the filer's typo for Bountiful, kept verbatim

_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: exact - 6 rows sum to 5,809.71 = the page's own '>$50' box, the page's in-grid total, AND the cover. split50 form, but its '<=$50' box is 0.00, so unlike the usual pre-2022 filing there is no unitemized aggregate residual here.

expenditures.detail: exact - the single row (Summit County Clerk, file fees) reproduces the page's own printed 'Total amount of expenditures' box and the cover.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2 ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT is the pre-2022 split50 form and prints TWO boxed totals above the grid - 'Total amount from donors giving more than $50' $5,809.71 and 'giving $50 or less' $0.00 - plus a THIRD printed total inside the grid itself, $5,809.71, four rows under the last entry. The 6 rows reproduce all three to the cent. Because the <=$50 box is 0.00 there is NO structural residual on this filing: the >$50 box, the in-grid total and the module's stated total are the same number. p3 ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT prints 'Total amount of expenditures $687.52' and its single row reproduces it. No specimen rows on the 2018 form. GLYPH-VS-ARITHMETIC: the county scanner's OCR layer reads the first contribution as $2,109.71, which would leave the side 200.00 short of every printed total; the full-page read at 200 dpi and a 700 dpi row crop both show $2,309.71, and 2,309.71 + 100 + 200 + 100 + 100 + 3,000 = 5,809.71 exactly. The OCR layer was not trusted (draft.py is not a reader).

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: Justin Martinez, County Sheriff, 2018 Pre-Election. 3 pages, TYPED on the county's pre-2022 split50 form (no handwriting anywhere). The scan carries the county's OCR text layer but it is unreliable on figures - it turned $2,309.71 into $2,109.71 and dropped one contributor's name entirely - so every value here comes from the page image, with the arithmetic gate deciding. NOT REDACTED and no privacy problem in the source: the Mailing Address column prints full street addresses, which were discarded AT READ TIME; only donor_city and donor_state were kept. The first contribution row is not an outside donation at all - it is the candidate's unspent 2014 committee balance rolled forward, and its address cell holds that description instead of an address. GEOMETRY: p2's vertical rules are not detected at all (rowbands returns no column rules), so the record supplies x/w while the 82 measured bands - the form's own empty rows, pitch 0.96 - carry y; data rows are bands 4-9 (band 3 is the column header). p3's rules ARE detected across the full table (8.3-49.2%), so its single row is fully measured at band 2. Verified at 700 dpi: p2 band 4 -> '3/9/18 2014 Campaign / Unspent funds from the 2014 campaign / $2,309.71', p2 band 9 -> '10/18/18 Richelle Skaggs / Salt Lake City / 84115 / $3,000.00'.
